title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.20643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. translated_title: 基于双层数据选择的保安全医疗大语言模型微调
translated_abstract: 随着通用大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被适配用于面向患者的医疗应用，如何在提升医疗能力的同时控制面向患者的风险仍然是一个关键挑战。大规模医疗指令数据对于通过监督微调（SFT）获取领域知识至关重要，但不安全的响应可能会破坏已有的安全对齐。为解决这一问题，我们提出了用于保安全医疗SFT的可扩展双层数据选择方法（S-BDS）。通过控制选择权重的集中度，S-BDS能够在大型候选池上实现可靠的样本排序，并识别出既能提升医疗能力又能控制面向患者风险的训练样本。我们将临床医生验证的安全数据与从未经筛查的医疗指令数据中选出的数据相结合进行SFT，并分别在HealthBench和PatientSafetyBench上联合评估医疗能力和面向患者的安全性。
tldr: 提出了S-BDS可扩展双层数据选择方法，通过双层优化从未经筛查的医疗指令数据中筛选出既提升医疗能力又保持安全对齐的训练样本，实现面向患者的保安全医疗大模型微调。
en_tdlr: Proposes S-BDS, a scalable bilevel data selection method that identifies training examples improving medical capability while preserving safety alignment, enabling safety-preserving medical LLM fine-tuning for patient-facing applications.
